usage.finalMessage:
I added `credit <customer> <amount>` and listed it in `help` directly after `balance`. `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes (9 of 9, including new tests I wrote for cases the provided tests didn't cover), and the work is committed.
A credit lowers the customer's balance but isn't applied to any specific invoice. Under DEC-B02, any amount above what the customer owes is held as refundable credit and isn't used against later invoices.
Open questions for Finance are in `.work/report.json`: whether a credit should be applied to specific invoices (late fees are still charged on invoices a credit already covers), and how refundable credit gets shown or paid out.
OUTCOME: completed
